soundness_flags.label: thm:projected-construction
soundness_flags.one_line: Once def:macro-scm, def:split-projection-maps, and the selector equation are adopted, the displayed intervention cases and partial-projection identity are direct equation substitution plus Xia--Bareinboim's general projection definition.

soundness_flags.label: thm:sharp-envelope
soundness_flags.one_line: Theta_h is defined over precisely the calibrated selectors, gamma=p s is defined as their coupling, and the converse selector is built in def:common-response-witness, so the interval equality is a direct image-of-definition calculation rather than a substantive new identification theorem.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-changing-support
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform primitive Gaussian and conditional multiplier approximations are assumed, not derived from the sampling design.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any uniform paired-coverage result is conditional on ass:uniform-primitive-clt and ass:uniform-multiplier-law, together with the stated shrinking-margin regime.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PMLR record, pages 68225--68235 and abstract; linked proceedings PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings record states that projected abstractions accommodate lossy representations and construct a projected abstraction translating observational, interventional, and counterfactual queries.

The paper gives numerical-directional-derivative consistency when the step vanishes and dominates estimation error, and separately proves uniform size control over a DGP class under additional uniform conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Causal Inference 1(1) (2013), author manuscript with final-journal metadata
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies causal effects with multiple treatment versions and explains that policy effects depend on how versions are assigned.

source_verification_receipts.version: Published version metadata: Review of Economic Studies 92(1) (2025), 238--267; accessible corroborating working-paper version
source_verification_receipts.locator: NBER abstract and Published Versions record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible version says the paper derives a constructive sharp identified set for a partially linear model with unlinked datasets using optimal transport; the cited published theorem/equation numbering was not independently inspected, so no formula-level mismatch is asserted.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the shrinking-margin paired-coverage question the sole headline and state a concrete candidate boundary rate for kappa_n, with an explicit least-favourable triangular-array route for failure below it.

Demote the selector-SCM image calculation and the projection case split to construction/proof infrastructure; retain them only if a new observable restriction yields a strictly tighter set than the unrestricted transportation envelope.

Add a direct comparison to Hong--Li Section 3.2: identify exactly which of its uniform-class hypotheses fails or remains unproved as margins shrink, and prove why the paired max-critical-value construction is not covered.

recommended_next_step: Revise around a non-definitional changing-support inference frontier, retaining the SCM/transport construction as infrastructure and preserving the accepted conditional scope for primitive uniform approximations.
